    A multiplicative basis of A₀ from homogeneous vectors #

    Proposition 4.14 (scalar-normalization.tex): the invariant basis "descends to one vector on each homogeneous ray line of A₀: such a line lies in one deck degree […]. Products lift uniquely, so every nonzero coefficient downstairs is one."

    For a graded family whose nonzero homogeneous pieces A(x, y)_g are lines spanned by chosen vectors b(x, y, g) closed under composition up to zero, with identities b(x, x, 1) = 𝟙, the matrix units of the b(x, y, g) form a basis of (Alg F)ᵒᵖ (basisA0) which is multiplicative and contains the idempotents of the labels (basisA0_isMultiplicative, basisA0_idempotents).
